description: Search youth programs in the cities Kyds Activities serves, city by city (call list_cities for the live list; pass `city`, defaults to Lodi, CA). Filter by free-text query (program name or description), category (Sports, Music, Arts, Academics, Swimming, etc.), child age (integer in years — programs that accept that age), free-only flag, or season. Returns up to 15 matching programs with full details for decision-making (cost, schedule, location, registration status).

age.description: Child age in years. Returns programs whose age range includes this age.

category.description: Program category. Common values: Sports, Music, Arts, Academics, Swimming, Gymnastics, Dance, Enrichment, Free Programs.

city.description: City slug to search in (e.g. 'lodi', 'galt'). Defaults to Lodi. Call list_cities for the current list.

free_only.description: If true, only return programs with $0 cost.

query.description: Free-text search across program name + description (case-insensitive substring match).

name: search_programs
